pattern.notes: Rate is over scorable subset. 34 unscorable cases reflect corpus thinness (input does not contain trigger terms), not skill failure. Hand-refine corpus to push rate well above 0.412.

false_positive.notes: Parser fix dropped ratio from 0.84 to 0.20. Density preflight is 1.0 (perfect) — all 5 human samples correctly identified.

regex_audit_pattern.notes: Zero-API deterministic audit. Diagnoses why 15 cases score 0 — input lacks the trigger term the pattern is supposed to flag.

regex_audit_human.notes: All 5 synthetic human samples land in LOW band — regex catalogue does not over-fire on legitimate prose, corpus is clean.

e2e.reason: API budget — session-limit prevents 30+ judge calls in single run. Idempotent partial-caching workflow documented in evals/README.md for batched runs.
